scientific_status: causal retrospective cross-surface development; not sealed validation
purpose: Test direct payoff-state modelling, causal route-branch forecasting, and route-plus-price sequential payoff modelling for the two frozen loop orientations without reopening their 2023 or 2025 payoff surfaces.

sealed_data_status.reason: 2024 was previously used for causal research and no immutable pre-hypothesis seal exists; the expected-leg-then-diversion payoff hypothesis remains reserved for genuinely new observations.

population.surface_relation_to_parent: different causal breakout surface; tests mechanism transfer, not an exact rerun of breakout_loop_scores_range_p75

causal_clock.admission: OCO breakout fill inside the provider bar at anchor position plus entry_step.
causal_clock.admission_features: Only anchor-close information, prior completed bars, signal values known at fill, and state transitions strictly before the entry bar are allowed.
causal_clock.entry_bar_state: Forbidden at admission because its completed-bar label is unavailable until that bar closes.
causal_clock.sequential_state: A transition or price-path feature becomes available only after its 5-minute bar closes.
causal_clock.sequential_exit: Hypothetical next provider open after a completed checkpoint bar; same-bar execution is forbidden.
causal_clock.training: Every prediction is fit only from rows belonging to completed sessions strictly before the score session.
causal_clock.intrabar_order: Unknown; sequential MFE and MAE exclude the entry bar and use only fully completed post-entry bars.

outcomes.admission_primary: frozen anchor+24 gross return minus 10 bps round-trip cost
outcomes.route_label: five-way outcome-only topology through anchor+24: no_transition, expected_leg_partial, exact_parent_completion, incompatible_first_transition, expected_leg_then_diversion
outcomes.sequential_primary: hold advantage in bps: frozen-close gross payoff minus checkpoint-next-open gross payoff
outcomes.sequential_policy_payoff: next-open gross payoff minus round-trip cost when a negative-exit class is emitted, otherwise frozen-close net payoff

sequential_checkpoints.ordinal_rule: ceil(fraction * bars_from_entry_to_frozen_close), deduplicated, requiring 1 <= checkpoint_offset < bars_from_entry_to_frozen_close
sequential_checkpoints.reason: fixed quartiles of each remaining holding window; not selected from opened V2/V3 excursion timing

sequential_route_only_features.inherit: all admission features plus causal prequential route probabilities

route_forecast.probability_floor: mix fitted probabilities with 2 percent uniform mass across the five frozen classes
route_forecast.baseline: candidate-specific Dirichlet-smoothed class prior with alpha=1

payoff_models.type: BayesianRidge after median/mode imputation, standardisation, and dense one-hot encoding
payoff_models.interpretation: bounded ridge partial-pooling proxy, not a claim of a fully specified hierarchical Bayesian market model

uncertainty_class.interval: two-sided 90 percent posterior-predictive interval using z=1.6448536269514722
uncertainty_class.point_mean_policy: reported only as an uncertainty-ignoring diagnostic and cannot qualify

hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Determine whether compact causal admission information supports a calibrated positive/negative/unknown net-payoff state.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: A forced rank or outcome-derived threshold could manufacture coverage.
hypotheses.validation_command: uv run pytest work/tests/test_causal_payoff_model_paths_v1.py && uv run python work/audit_causal_payoff_model_paths_v1.py --artifact <output>
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject if positive-class coverage, paired advantage, uncertainty, month stability, leave-one-stock-out robustness, or 5-bps-per-side absolute payoff fails in either candidate.

hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Test whether the future five-way route topology is forecastable causally rather than merely known after completion.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: Using realised topology, entry-bar state, or future run duration in features would create direct leakage.
hypotheses.validation_command: independent audit must prove every route training session precedes its score session and the feature allowlist excludes outcome fields
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject route forecasting if log-loss improvement over the candidate prior is not positive with a multiplicity-controlled block interval for pooled and both candidate surfaces.

hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Test causal route probabilities as auxiliary payoff features without substituting route identity for payoff.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: In-sample route probabilities would transmit the realised route label into the payoff model.
hypotheses.validation_command: audit every stored route probability as a prequential prediction made before the row session
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject incremental route value if admission-plus-route does not improve forecast error and conservative selector payoff over admission-only in both candidates.

hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Test whether causal route state joined to completed-bar excursion and retracement identifies when holding to anchor+24 has negative remaining expectancy.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: Selecting checkpoint bars or retracement thresholds from opened MFE/MAE paths would be post-inspection tuning.
hypotheses.validation_command: audit fixed quartile checkpoints, exclusion of entry-bar excursions, strict next-open exits, and rolling prior-session training
hypotheses.stop_condition: Reject if the uncertainty-aware policy lacks coverage or fails paired fixed-close, route-only, month, stock-deletion, cost, and block-interval gates in either candidate.

hypotheses.expected_research_benefit: Preserve the strongest V3 branch hypothesis for a genuinely prospective test.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: Testing or tuning it on any already-opened period would convert a post-inspection pattern into false validation.
hypotheses.validation_command: decision artifact must record deferred_no_sealed_data and no diversion-specific payoff or exit table may be emitted
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not score until a new immutable data seal and activation timestamp exist.

evaluation.primary_multiplicity: Separate Holm families across the three pooled/candidate endpoints for route log-loss, direct admission selector, and sequential route-plus-price policy.
economic_metrics: per-opportunity selector return with abstentions zero
direct_admission_gate: score support >= 50 in pooled and both candidate groups
uncertainty-aware positive coverage >= 5 percent in pooled and both candidates
selected mean net payoff > 0 at 5 bps per side in pooled and both candidates
paired selector-minus-unfiltered mean > 0 with 95 percent block lower bound > 0 and Holm pass in pooled and both candidates
positive paired selector difference in a majority of scored calendar months in both candidates
positive paired selector difference in at least 16 of 20 leave-one-stock-out deletions
forecast Spearman correlation > 0 in pooled and both candidates
route_forecast_gate: score support >= 50 in pooled and both candidate groups
route log-loss improvement over prior > 0 with 95 percent block lower bound > 0 and Holm pass in all three groups
model multiclass Brier score lower than prior in all three groups
positive log-loss improvement in a majority of scored calendar months in both candidates
route_increment_gate: admission-plus-route RMSE lower than admission-only in both candidates
admission-plus-route conservative selector paired return higher than admission-only in both candidates
sequential_gate: score support >= 50 in pooled and both candidate groups
uncertainty-aware exit coverage >= 5 percent in pooled and both candidates
paired policy-minus-fixed mean > 0 with 95 percent block lower bound > 0 and Holm pass in all three groups
route-plus-price paired return higher than route-state-only in both candidates
absolute route-plus-price policy mean net > 0 at 5 bps per side in pooled and both candidates
positive paired fixed-close difference in a majority of scored calendar months in both candidates
positive paired fixed-close difference in at least 16 of 20 leave-one-stock-out deletions
